name: asks
title: Asks
description: A fixture for pilot-ext-host's asks (T11): confirmAlert in the panel, AI.ask through Pilot's AI page, getSelectedText read as the command runs, and command arguments.
author: banozz

commands.name: index
commands.title: Confirm a thing
commands.description: Delete the thing asks first; its answer shows on the Status row.

commands.name: ai
commands.title: Ask the AI
commands.description: Asks AI.ask once as it opens, loading until the answer comes.

commands.name: selection
commands.title: Read the selection
commands.description: Reads getSelectedText once as it opens.

commands.name: quiet
commands.title: Never reads
commands.description: A view that never calls getSelectedText or AI.ask.

commands.name: say
commands.title: Say
commands.description: Says its arguments in its HUD line.
